title: oz-policy-builder and Perch, side by side.
caption: Read from source at the pins; nothing here is measured. The full table, with a source for each cell, is in the oz-policy-builder companion paper.

Release {{fact:opb-release}} and later commits; interpreter pinned on testnet, none on mainnet (`config.ts:57-80`); installs on existing OpenZeppelin accounts (0.7.2-line and {{fact:oz-v080-tag}} builds, `policy-synth/README.md:143`)

None completed
Tested on real transactions

{{fact:opb-corpus-calls}} mainnet transactions of {{fact:opb-corpus-shapes}} shapes, including SEP-41 transfers, Soroswap swaps and Blend submits, taken from synthesis to the interpreter (`packages/policy-synth/src/corpus.test.ts:1-3`; `fixtures/corpus/mainnet.json`); scripted testnet runs of the executor binding, the adapter, a no-gate liquidation and the {{fact:oz-v080-tag}} migration (`evidence/README.md:18-24`)
{{fact:nido-run-transactions}} transactions through {{fact:wallet-name}}'s testnet preview; local reference runs
Authoring

Record a transaction or state an Intent, synthesise a predicate and test that each conjunct is needed, verify it against the deployed `check`, review, unsigned install; {{fact:opb-tools-count}} tools over a CLI and an MCP server; three packages at {{fact:opb-packages-version}} (`README.md:13-24`; `packages/*/package.json:3`)
Write a grant document (perch-js builder); the account's compiler validates it at install
Conditions on a call
And/or, comparisons, quantifiers over lists, ledger-clock windows (`until`/`from`), slippage floors (`minOut`), reads of other contracts (`dsl.rs:84-158`; `intent.ts:18-49`)
Target, functions, {{fact:doc-conditions-count}} conjunctive argument conditions, threshold, expiry; no reads
Limit over time
OpenZeppelin `spending_limit`, a separate opt-in policy on `transfer` (`docs/stellar.md:404-407`; `install.ts:957-967`)
A window cap inside the rule, charged in the same decision (T6)
Where it is decided
The account's checks, then each attached policy in stored order
One decision function in the account
Signers
Delegated signers on policed rules; thresholds through a threshold policy (`README.md:122-125`)
External (passkey, Ed25519) and delegated; threshold in the rule
What a refusal reports
A deny code per reason (`policy-interpreter/src/storage.rs:27-86`)
Auth error {{fact:auth-error-stale-grant}} or {{fact:auth-error-rule-eval-refused}}
Evidence about the decision
Tests, partly on the shipped Wasm; a STRIDE threat register
Lean proofs about the evaluator's translation; the account code around it tested
Ending authority
Rules removed one at a time
One owner call per grant; a completed recovery stops every earlier grant from authorizing through the account
